chapter: Sue and Patsy Howard in show business
title: Sue Howard singing with the band
summary: Howard and Willard discuss whether Sue sang with the band at the Cotton Club, Nightingale and Hummingbird; Marshall Royal praised her singing.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Yeah. And she could stand up and sing, too.
Did Mrs. Howard ever sing with your band?
I don't know whether she -- we worked the same places, but I don't know whether she sang with the band or not. Did you, Mama?
Where was I during the time the band played at the Cotton Club? And the Nightingale and the Hummingbird?
She was singing there, singing with the band, yeah. Oh, I'd forgotten what she's talking about.
But you didn't forget she's a good
Oh, she can sing. She makes me mad sometimes.
Yeah, we heard about you, Sue.
I read some of those stories in the papers there.
And Marshall Royal talked about her when we did the oral history with Marshall Royal singing, too, (inaudible) He said you were a very important singer (inaudible) here in Los Angeles.
Yeah, Marshall, he's a nice boy.
